diagnosis: The failure is caused by the flat three-way `rcases` pattern in the `ite` case: the membership hypothesis is nested as `(A ∨ B) ∨ C`, and dependent list-membership elimination cannot flatten it directly. After unfolding, every non-`app` case is elementary propositional reasoning; the special old-expression `app` branch still needs explicit splitting before automation.
proof_body:
by
  induction post <;>
    simp only [OldExpressions.substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset, List.mem_append,
      List.mem_singleton] at *
  case app m fn e fnih eih =>
    split
    · split <;>
        simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
    · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset, List.mem_append,
          List.mem_singleton] at fnih eih ⊢
      grind
  all_goals grind
